turbine_standard.label: Retail rule: buy a side at 45¢ or less, sell at 70¢ (hold to settlement otherwise)
turbine_standard.assumption: A rule circulated in bot tutorials and vendor marketing for BTC 15-minute markets; it is not any one vendor's product (Turbine, where we first saw it quoted, is a bot-builder platform, not a fixed-rule bot). If 70¢ is never bid, the position is held to settlement.
turbine_standard.verdict_why: 717 trades; the 95% interval is entirely below zero

turbine_reference.label: Turbine reference bot: buy the side the live price favours vs. the strike (10 bps threshold, confidence-priced limits)
turbine_reference.assumption: The 'price action bot' in Turbine's turbine-py-client docs, as documented there: 10 bps threshold, confidence 0.6 to 0.9 scaled with distance from the strike and used as the limit price, buy repeatedly up to a per-market maximum, stop with 60 s left, hold to settlement. Documented on Pyth prices; replayed on the CF Benchmarks prints the market settles on. A reference implementation, not a product the vendor sells as a strategy.
turbine_reference.verdict_why: 54 trades; the 95% interval (-13% to +28% per dollar) includes zero or the sample is under 100

astrotick_feeaware.label: AstroTick, fee-aware favorite (last 120 s)
astrotick_feeaware.assumption: Rule as summarised on the project README: favoured side by the running settlement average, offered at or below 90¢, margin >= 5 bps, positive fee-adjusted edge.

coinflip_open.label: Control: buy Up at the open, hold
coinflip_open.verdict_why: 408 trades; the 95% interval is entirely below zero
